brief: A caddy for next to my kitchen sink: a dispenser that pours out bleach for wiping the counters, plus two bins for sponges.

requirements.evidence: No printed dispenser built. 3D-printed parts are user-chosen material and the configurator checks fit only, so chemical compatibility and leak-proof pouring of bleach cannot be verified. Third cell (bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full) is a plain holder sized for a store-bought sealed bleach bottle, not a printed pourer.
requirements.requirement: Dispenser that pours out bleach for wiping counters

requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain — two full-depth drained trays that let wet sponges drip dry next to sink.
3 full bases (0,0 / 0,1 / 1,0) joined with side connectors, open faces capped, joints locked; check_build ok, meshClash clear.
requirements.requirement: Caddy for next to kitchen sink

finish.summary: Built a 3-cell sink-side caddy: two drained bins for sponges plus a plain bin that holds (not dispenses) a store-bought bleach bottle. A 3D-printed bleach pourer cannot be verified safe — material, chemical resistance and leak-proofing are outside what the configurator checks — so keep bleach in its original sealed container and use it per its label, never poured from a printed part.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Bleach caddy with sponge bins — I'll sort a safe pourer and storage.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

events.text: That bleach pourer needs a chemical-safe, leak-proof build I can't verify here — I'll check what safe storage I can do instead.
